mapper.sql: SELECT COALESCE(m.media_url, mr.url) FROM goods_room_category_rel rel JOIN room_category_media m ON m.room_category_id = rel.room_category_id AND m.status = 1 LEFT JOIN media_resource mr ON mr.media_resource_id = m.media_resource_id AND mr.is_deleted = 0 WHERE rel.goods_id = gm.goods_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN m.scene_type = 'cover' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, m.sort_no ASC, m.media_id ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.select:
SELECT gm.goods_id AS goodsId, gm.goods_type AS rawGoodsType, gm.name AS channelRoomCategoryName, gm.room_category_type AS roomCategoryType, CAST(( SELECT rel.room_category_id FROM goods_room_category_rel rel WHERE rel.goods_id = gm.goods_id ORDER BY rel.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS CHAR) AS parentRoomCategoryId, CAST(( SELECT m.media_resource_id FROM goods_room_category_rel rel JOIN room_category_media m ON m.room_category_id = rel.room_category_id AND m.status = 1 WHERE rel.goods_id = gm.goods_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN m.scene_type = 'cover' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, m.sort_no ASC, m.media_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS CHAR) AS mainPhotoMediaId, () AS mainPhotoMediaUrl, () AS mainPhoto, gm.selling_price_cent AS defaultSellingPrice, gm.original_price_cent AS defaultOriginalPrice, gm.settlement_price_cent AS defaultSettlementPrice, gm.stock_mode AS stockMode, gm.shelf_status AS shelfStatus, CAST(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(gm.effective_start_at) * 1000 AS SIGNED) AS effectiveStartTime, CAST(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(gm.effective_end_at) * 1000 AS SIGNED) AS effectiveEndTime, gm.description AS description, CAST(( SELECT dp.distribution_product_id FROM distribution_product dp WHERE dp.goods_id = gm.goods_id AND dp.status = 1 ORDER BY dp.distribution_product_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS CHAR) AS applyId FROM goods_main gm WHERE gm.camp_id = #{campId} AND gm.is_deleted = 0 AND gm.status = 'published'
AND gm.room_category_type IN
#{roomCategoryType}
AND ( gm.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR gm.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY gm.goods_id ASC
